# Lint rules

The rule table of `privatium lint` as the crate holds it — `spec/cli.md §5.1`'s rules with their stable IDs, severities, what the linter reads for each, and the section every finding cites. `privatium lint apps/<slug>` exits 3 on findings; `--format json` writes one object per finding with `id`, `severity`, `file`, `line`, `message`, `fix` and `spec` (`§5.2`); `--severity error|warn|info` is the floor; `--fix` applies the mechanical corrections of `§5.3` — a literal mount path to `url()`, `focusable="false"` on an inline icon — and nothing else.

## Contract

| ID | Severity | Rule | Reads | Spec |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PV101` | error | app.toml parses and carries slug, title, version, api, tier | app.toml | `spec/app-contract.md §3` |
| `PV102` | error | Slug matches ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,30}$ and is not reserved | app.toml | `spec/app-contract.md §3.1` |
| `PV103` | error | api does not exceed the framework's supported version | app.toml | `spec/protocol.md §12` |
| `PV104` | error | Slug directory name matches app.slug | app.toml, the folder name | `spec/app-contract.md §3.1` |
| `PV105` | error | Tier-required files present and every Lua file and template parses | app.lua, web/index.html, lib/, views/ | `spec/app-contract.md §8` |
| `PV106` | error | Every table in schema.sql has id VARCHAR PRIMARY KEY | schema.sql, through the engine's catalog | `spec/app-contract.md §4.5` |
| `PV107` | error | schema.sql contains only CREATE TABLE, CREATE VIEW, CREATE INDEX and comments | schema.sql, one statement at a time under the engine's authorizer | `spec/app-contract.md §4.5` |
| `PV108` | error | No UNIQUE constraint or index beyond id's primary key | schema.sql, through the engine's catalog | `spec/app-contract.md §4.5` |

## Security

| ID | Severity | Rule | Reads | Spec |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PV201` | error | No string-concatenated SQL — parameters must be bound | Lua and templates (AST), Tier 2 JavaScript | `spec/lua-api.md §3.2` |
| `PV202` | warn | Every <?raw ?> use is reported for review | views/*.lsp | `spec/lua-api.md §4` |
| `PV203` | error | No banned Lua global — io, os.execute, os.getenv, debug, load, dofile, package.loadlib, and the rest of the sandbox's closed list | Lua and templates (AST) | `spec/lua-api.md §5` |
| `PV204` | error | Every non-GET form contains csrf() | views/*.lsp | `spec/lua-api.md §4.1` |
| `PV205` | warn | Declared [permissions] beyond the defaults carry a justifying comment | app.toml | `spec/app-contract.md §5.4` |
| `PV206` | error | No innerHTML with non-literal data in Tier 2 JavaScript | web/**/*.js | `spec/app-contract.md §5.4` |
| `PV207` | error | No external origin referenced without a matching permissions.remote entry | templates, web/, static/ | `spec/app-contract.md §5.4` |
| `PV208` | error | No apparent secret in schema.sql, app.toml, or sample data | schema.sql, app.toml, sample/seed.jsonl | `spec/protocol.md §3` |

## Correctness

| ID | Severity | Rule | Reads | Spec |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PV301` | error | No literal /a/<slug>/ path — use url() or pv.url() (breaks solo mode) | Lua, templates, web/ (strings and attributes) | `spec/app-contract.md §2.2` |
| `PV302` | error | No tonumber() or JavaScript Number() applied to a DECIMAL or BIGINT column | Lua and templates (AST) and web/ JavaScript, against schema.sql | `spec/data-dictionary.md §2.1` |
| `PV303` | error | No INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE in app SQL — writes are appends | the SQL literals of Lua, templates and JavaScript | `spec/app-contract.md §7` |
| `PV304` | error | Client code does not set seq, lam, ts, dev, or app on an event | web/ JavaScript | `spec/data-api.md §2` |
| `PV305` | warn | No outbox dedupe table, transaction ID, or acknowledgement protocol | schema.sql, Lua, JavaScript (names) | `spec/protocol.md §10.6` |
| `PV306` | warn | Multi-event writes that must land together use pv.batch | Lua (AST), JavaScript | `spec/lua-api.md §3.3` |
| `PV307` | warn | No global assigned in a handler expecting persistence, and no load-time table mutated from one | Lua (AST) | `spec/lua-api.md §5` |
| `PV308` | error | No SUM() over a DECIMAL column and no + or - on a DATE column in app SQL | the SQL literals of Lua, templates and JavaScript, and CREATE VIEW in schema.sql | `spec/data-dictionary.md §2` |
